mechanism_narrative: A rising federal funds rate (measured as the 3-month change in FEDFUNDS) compresses equity valuations by increasing the discount rate for future cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS has increased by more than 0.5% over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%) signals a tight labor market that supports strong consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%) and strong consumer spending growth (RSAFS growth > 0.5% MoM) signals a robust economic expansion that supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when both UNRATE < 3.5 and RSAFS growth > 0.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), the S&P 500 produces negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to higher discount rates and reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 3 months signals a weakening manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the slowdown impacts corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO has declined by more than 0.5% over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts rate above 1700 thousand units signals strong consumer confidence and economic activity, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances when HOUST > 1700, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is growing at more than 0.5% and employment (PAYEMS) is growing at more than 0.3%, the economy is in a strong expansion phase that supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances when both INDPRO growth > 0.5% and PAYEMS growth > 0.3%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a strong consumer demand regime (RSAFS > 680,000), the S&P 500 produces positive forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to robust corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances when RSAFS > 680,000, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
